paragraphs.text: Extract transcripts from Douyin/Kuaishou share links or local video files. 抖音/快手视频转文字。
> Douyin/Kuaishou share link → metadata; local video file → full speech transcript.
抖音/快手分享链接 → 标题/作者/点赞等元数据（**无需 Cookie**）；本地视频 → 语音转写全文。
No build step, no account, no telemetry.
Ask your agent: *"把这个抖音链接的文案提取出来"* → it picks the right mode for you.
macOS ships `avconvert`; on Linux install `ffmpeg`. Share-link parsing needs no dependencies at all.
Metadata mode is honestly metadata: it does **not** download or transcribe the video. Transcription
runs only on local files. Both paths are self-hosted — nothing is sent to a third-party service.

MIT — see LICENSE. Issues and PRs welcome.
Part of the hermes-skills collection.
